an6.19:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
an6.19:1.6: maraṇasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
an6.19:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.19:2.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:2.5: “aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti.
an6.19:2.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti. (2)
an6.19:3.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:3.5: “aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti.
an6.19:3.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti. (3)
an6.19:4.3: yathā kathampana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:4.5: “aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti.
an6.19:4.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti. (4)
an6.19:5.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:5.5: “aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti.
an6.19:5.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti. (5)
an6.19:6.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:6.5: “aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti
an6.19:6.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti. (6)
an6.19:7.3: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatinti?
an6.19:7.5: “aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi. bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā”ti.
an6.19:7.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatinti.
an6.19:8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā te bhikkhū etadavoca: (1)
an6.19:8.2: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:8.3: aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (2)
an6.19:9.1: ‘yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:9.2: aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (3)
an6.19:10.1: ‘yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:10.2: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (4)
an6.19:11.1: ‘yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:11.2: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (1, 2, 3, 4)
an6.19:12.1: ‘ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhū pamattā viharanti, dandhaṃ maraṇa satiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya. (5)
an6.19:13.1: ‘yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:13.2: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (6)
an6.19:14.1: ‘yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.19:14.2: aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi. passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assā’ti- (5, 6)
an6.19:15.1: ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhū appamattā viharanti tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an6.19:16.2: appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāvessāma āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
